findings.finding: 需求、问题、数据、解决方案、CodeBuddy Prompt、演示、实现与排错各重复 24 次。
findings.impact: Half of the heading hierarchy describes the template instead of the case.

findings.finding: The Prompt chapter uses 899 lines and 120 table rows for 18 short experiments.
findings.impact: Frequent visual resets obscure the progression from task definition to evaluation.

findings.finding: The Agent plus Skills chapter contains 53 level-three headings and repeats the same scene and CodeBuddy labels.
findings.impact: Distinct artifacts read like one generated worksheet repeated nine times.

findings.finding: All 24 cases follow one flat sequence without narrative group transitions.
findings.impact: Readers cannot see why one case follows another or which capability is being combined.

findings.finding: Verification and delivery vocabulary still appears in reader-facing paragraphs even when the underlying fact is useful.
findings.impact: The course sometimes explains its production process instead of the subject.
